name: Music Meta by Mozbeats
author: Ermelindo João Rosário

sections.description:
Music Meta by Mozbeats is a WordPress plugin built for music websites. It reads the post title, detects the main artist, featured artists, release year, music genre, and release type, then creates a professional music metadata block automatically.

The plugin can be used with shortcodes, custom post templates, automatic insertion, and optional Premium features. Version 1.4.7 adds Premium release presentation layouts for cover artwork, title, and description, plus a safer playlist connection method using a unique playlist code.

Main Features

Smart artist detection

  • Detects the main artist automatically from the post title.
  • Supports multiple artists in the same title.
  • Detects featured artists using feat. and ft.
  • Improves grammar in automatic descriptions.
  • Updates generated tags when the post title changes.

Tag and taxonomy tools

  • Creates tags for the main artist, featured artists, and year.
  • Keeps manually added tags.
  • Removes old tags generated automatically by the plugin.
  • Lets you choose whether artists and genres are read from tags or categories.

Technical Sheet

  • Main shortcode: [mozbeats_ficha_tecnica]
  • Alias shortcodes: [mozbeats_ft] and [gerar_ficha_tecnica]
  • Template variable: $ficha_tecnica
  • Extra fields for quality, file size, duration, production, and rating.
  • Premium visual styles for music websites.

Safe Download Button

  • Download link field for each post.
  • Multiple download links with Enter-to-add support in the post editor.
  • Download counter.
  • Google Drive shared link conversion when possible.
  • Alternative download links in Premium.

Premium Playlists

  • Creates Premium playlists for Album, EP, and Mixtape main posts.
  • Playlist modes: automatic, main post, numbered track, or disabled.
  • Album, EP, and Mixtape posts can act as playlist main posts without track numbers.
  • Tracks are ordered by track number.
  • Version 1.4.7 adds a Premium playlist linking mode by unique code, so tracks can be connected without pasting the main post URL.
  • Template variable: $playlist_premium

Premium Release Layouts

Version 1.4.7 adds a new Premium option for the cover artwork, title, and description area:

  • Current Classic: keeps the previous layout.
  • Editorial Music: clean centered cover and text.
  • Studio Cover: cover artwork beside the release description, designed for music sites.
  • Dark Premium: modern dark presentation for albums, EPs, mixtapes, and singles.

Manual descriptions and custom templates continue to work. If a custom template already places $ficha_tecnica, $botao_download, or $playlist_premium manually, the plugin respects that layout.

Premium Options

Premium features include:

  • Five download button styles.
  • Custom download button text.
  • Alternative download links.
  • JSON backup export.
  • Backup import.
  • Four Technical Sheet styles.
  • Premium release presentation layouts.
  • Premium playlist for Album, EP, and Mixtape posts.
  • Playlist linking by main post URL or unique playlist code.
  • Front-end copy protection for generated model content.
  • Automatic Technical Sheet insertion in posts.
  • Per-post option to disable automatic insertion.

License Management

License key management is handled outside the main plugin by the Mozbeats License Manager mini plugin. Client sites only activate the key received after purchase.

  • $botao_download
  • $link_download

Shortcodes

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin in the WordPress dashboard.
  3. Open the Music Meta by Mozbeats settings page.
  4. Configure artist and genre sources, download options, templates, and Premium options if available.
  5. Add a shortcode to a post or enable automatic insertion in Premium.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin replace my manual post description?

No. Manual post content remains untouched. The plugin only renders the shortcode or automatic generated block where it is enabled.

Can I still use the old playlist link method?

Yes. Version 1.4.7 keeps the old main post URL method and adds the unique playlist code method as an optional Premium setting.

How does the playlist code work?

Use the same code, for example raro1, on the Album, EP, or Mixtape main post and on each track. Tracks with the same code are ordered by track number.

Can I choose different styles for the Technical Sheet and the release cover area?

Yes. The Technical Sheet style and the release layout are separate Premium settings.
sections.changelog:
1.4.7

  • Added Premium release layouts for cover artwork, title, and description: Editorial Music, Studio Cover, and Dark Premium.
  • Added a Premium setting to choose playlist linking by main post URL or unique playlist code.
  • Added a playlist code field to posts when code linking mode is active.
  • Kept compatibility with manual descriptions, custom templates, and the existing classic layout.

1.4.6

  • Improved title and featured artist extraction for titles using feat., ft., and dash separators.
  • Adjusted copy protection to apply only to generated model content and Premium playlists, keeping the download button usable.
  • Removed license key administration from the main plugin and kept key management in the Mozbeats License Manager mini plugin.
  • Kept the token-protected REST endpoint for purchase-based key creation in the mini plugin only.
  • Added automatic Premium key email support and WhatsApp support information.

1.4.5

  • Added Premium mode with per-user key activation.
  • Added the More Options +Premium dashboard section.
  • Added five download button styles and custom button text.
  • Improved the download metabox to add links with Enter before publishing.
  • Added support for multiple saved download links.
  • Added JSON backup export and import for settings, links, and post data connected to shortcodes.
  • Added the $ficha_tecnica variable to place the Technical Sheet anywhere in the active post model.
  • Added $botao_download, $link_download, $formato_ficheiro, $data_publicacao, $url_post, and $playlist_premium variables.
  • Added Premium Technical Sheet layouts.
  • Added Premium playlists for Album, EP, and Mixtape posts.
  • Added playlist modes for automatic, main post, numbered track, or disabled.
  • Added automatic Technical Sheet insertion for posts.
  • Added a per-post option to disable automatic insertion.

1.4.4

  • Updated declared WordPress compatibility.

1.4.3

  • Bug fixes.

1.4.2

  • Improved safe download button rules for albums, EPs, and mixtapes.
  • Google Drive links are converted to direct downloads only for music posts.
  • File size is displayed only for music posts or files uploaded to WordPress.
  • Added rich editing for custom text templates.
  • Improved biography shortcode conversion to permanent HTML.
  • Bulk conversion now processes posts in smaller batches to avoid server errors.
